name: zapier-calle
title: Zapier CALL-E integration
description: Zapier Platform CLI integration that places CALL-E phone calls, waits for the terminal outcome through a Zapier callback URL, and returns a fail-closed disposition alongside the transcript, summary, and structured result.

entrypoints.name: Place Call and Wait for Outcome

side_effects: Creates one outbound phone call per Zap run when Dry Run is false, a valid CALL-E API key is connected, and an authorized E.164 phone number is supplied.
safety: Dry Run defaults to on. Suppression, calling-window and retry guards run before a live create; blocked runs never generate a callback URL.
One authorized E.164 phone per Call, with a required closed flat scalar schema of at most 32 properties. Region and locale are optional; omitted hints stay omitted on replay.

The idempotency digest includes task, phone, region, locale, schema and metadata. Preserve the original Zap execution and callback URL. A changed URL with the original key conflicts rather than redialing.
Use the API resource id for paths and correlation. telephone_call_id is the nullable Billing identifier, not a resource id or proof of settled billing.
Wait only while result_status is pending. Empty available and final unavailable results never imply success or cause automatic redial.
Automatic business confirmation requires business_confirmed true, usable schema fields and a business_confirmed_quote grounded in the recipient transcript. No legacy confidence score is manufactured.
Top-level v2 transcript drives quote checks, review excerpts and English opt-out detection. Opt-out overrides business confirmation; unreadable transcripts cannot be actionable.

Both webhook surfaces read the Call through the authenticated API before acting. A resumed callback must match the original Call id and interface. Static notifications remain non-actionable and old successes are downgraded using the authenticated completion time.
Historical call_task callbacks and explicit v1 searches retain the legacy interface and classifier. Accepted v1 work must drain before moving its receiver.
Calls v2 has no provider attempt counts. Caller-supplied retry history is not a verified dial ledger; workflows depending on exact provider counts must resolve that dependency before migration.
Phone numbers are masked in previews, outputs and API error messages. This integration owns no recurring schedule, suppression database, or downstream write.
This source version has not been published or promoted to existing Zaps.
credentials: CALL-E API key stored in the Zapier connection as a password-typed field.

tested_with.calls_api: v2; local SDK callback simulation; hosted delivery not verified
